A '''heavy attack line''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[Captain of the Line/Legends|captain of the line]]. Attack lines numbered between four and eight [[Starship/Legends|starships]], none of which were smaller than a [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]]. Heavy attack lines were expected to engage and defeat enemy forces of similar numbers.
